currentRoundInspection.placement: The inspected aerial picture confirms the asymmetric Old Castle tower chain, two tall northern cones with warm crown bands, broad Papal cap, paired open western bastion and lower outer courts. Standard viewer PMTiles and the retained site frame establish approximate reference-anchor placement and northwest/southeast sign. The parent map ring is a broad compound boundary, not an exact tower footprint. A reconstructed11m working court clears coarse western ground; bounded walls/towers extend below sampled terrain. Individual tower centers and elevations remain approximate. Anchor 26.5625,48.67333333; heading 2.356194490192345; standard PMTiles datum 172.23851829222582m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground.
